site.name: OneLink GFTV
meta.description: One page for all your links, by Global Furry Television TIDSC.
language.modal.title: Choose a language
official.line: An official Global Furry Television website
official.domain-heading: Official GFTV sites end with globalfurry.tv or gftv.asia
official.domain-body: Read the address from the end, at the last dot before the first single slash. A site ending in anything else is not GFTV, even if the name appears earlier in the address.
official.trusted-link: The full list of official GFTV sites
official.secure-body: Look for a padlock, or https:// at the start of the address. Only share personal details on an official site over a secure connection.
update.label: Update
update.ready: A new version of OneLink GFTV is ready.
theme.title: Theme
theme.time-note: Following your device clock: light from {from} to {until}, dark the rest of the day. Currently {mode}.
home.lede: Put your socials, shop, music and more on one page, then share it with a single link or a QR code.
home.how-1-body: Pick a name for your page and set a password. No email needed.
home.how-2-body: Add as many links as you like, put them in order, and hide any for later. Or send visitors straight to one link.
home.how-3-body: Share your link anywhere, or show your QR code so people can scan it.
home.safe-1-body: Every page is locked with a password and an authenticator app or a passkey.
home.safe-2-body: Backup codes, and Telegram if you link it, get you back in if you lose your phone.
home.safe-3-body: Anyone can report a page or link, and the GFTV team reviews every report.
home.safe-4-body: Every link is checked against threat lists of more than two million harmful sites, again every day, and shortened links are not allowed.
slug.invalid: Use 2 to 32 lowercase letters, numbers or dashes, starting and ending with a letter or number.
field.slug-hint: 2 to 32 characters: lowercase letters, numbers and dashes.
field.password-hint: At least 10 characters. A few words together is easy to remember and hard to guess.
field.display-name-hint: Shown at the top of your page. Leave empty to show your page name.
totp.scan: Scan this with Google Authenticator or any authenticator app, then enter the six digit code it shows.
totp.manual: Can't scan? Enter this key instead
totp.qr-label: QR code for your authenticator app
passkey.explain: A passkey uses your phone or computer's screen lock, fingerprint or face to confirm it is you. Nothing to type.
passkey.unsupported: This browser cannot create passkeys. Use an authenticator app instead.
codes.title: Save your backup codes
codes.lede: Each code works once, in place of your authenticator or passkey. Keep them somewhere safe, away from your phone.
codes.replaced: Your old codes no longer work. Each of these works once.
codes.file-heading: OneLink GFTV backup codes for links.gftv.asia/{slug}. Each code works once.
register.title: Create your page
register.lede: Choose a name for your page and a password.
register.factor-lede: Editing needs a second step after your password. Choose one; you can add the other later.
login.title: Sign in to your page
login.lede: Enter your page name and password.
login.factor-lede: Confirm it is you with one of these.
login.help-totp: Open your authenticator app and enter the six digit code for OneLink GFTV.
login.help-passkey: Use the passkey you made for this page.
login.help-telegram: We will send a six digit code to the Telegram account linked to this page.
login.help-backup: Enter one of the backup codes you saved when you set up your page. Each one works once.
telegram.why: With Telegram linked, you can sign in with a code sent there, and reset a forgotten password.
telegram.steps: Open the bot and press Start. This link works once and expires in 10 minutes. Come back here when the bot says you are linked.
telegram.not-yet: Not linked yet. Press Start in the bot, then try again.
reset.title: Reset your password
reset.lede: There is no email on OneLink, so resetting a password needs two things: a code from Telegram, and your authenticator app, a passkey or a backup code.
reset.lost-factor: Lost your authenticator but know your password?
reset.use-backup: Sign in with a backup code
reset.none-body: This page has no Telegram account linked, so its password cannot be reset. If you still have your password, sign in and link Telegram from Security so this is possible next time.
reset.step-factor: 2. Confirm with your authenticator app, a passkey or a backup code.
reset.passkey-hint: Your browser asks for your passkey when you press the button below.
edit.title: Your page
edit.signed-out-body: Sign in to edit your page.
edit.banned-title: This page has been taken down
edit.banned-body: The GFTV team has taken this page down and it cannot be edited.
edit.links-empty: No links yet. Add your first one.
avatar.label: Profile picture
avatar.hint: A square crop is shown at the top of your page. It is shrunk and saved as WebP, without any location data.
avatar.canvas-label: Preview. Drag or use the arrow keys to move the picture, and plus or minus to zoom.
avatar.wheel-label: Colour wheel. Left and right arrows turn the hue, up and down change the saturation.
avatar.wheel-value: {hex}: hue {hue} degrees, saturation {sat} percent, brightness {bright} percent
avatar.preparing: Getting the background remover ready. The first time takes a moment.
avatar.downloading: Getting the background remover ready, first time only: {loaded} of {total} MB
avatar.see-through: This picture already has a see-through background. Add one behind it, or leave it as None.
avatar.removed-ok: Background removed. The picture is fitted inside the circle; choose what goes behind it.
edit.share-body: Print it, put it on a poster, or show it on your phone for people to scan.
link.username-invalid: That does not look like a {platform} username or ID. Check it, or choose "Website or other link" and paste the address.
share.title: Share this page
confirm.title: Confirm it is you
confirm.body: Enter your password to make this change.
security.factors-body: You need at least one of these to sign in. Having both means losing one does not lock you out.
security.last-factor: This is your only second step. Add another before removing it.
security.password-changed: Password changed. Other devices were signed out.
security.danger-body: This deletes your page, its links and its sign-in methods for good. The name becomes free for someone else.
profile.missing-body: There is no page at this address.
profile.banned-body: The GFTV team has taken this page down.
profile.offline-body: This page needs a connection to load. Try again when you are back online.
profile.saved-copy: You are offline. This is the copy saved on this device, and may be out of date.
report.title: Report
report.about-page: You are reporting the page links.gftv.asia/{slug}.
report.thanks: Thank you. The GFTV team will take a look.
notfound.title: Page not found uwu
notfound.body: There is no page at this address. It may have been renamed or deleted, or the link has a typo.
admin.login-lede: Sign in with your GFTV account. Admins and editors only.
admin.title: Moderation
admin.resolve-body: Resolve means action was taken. Add a note for the record if it helps.
admin.ban-body: The page stops showing straight away and its owner is signed out. The reason is kept in the audit log.
admin.remove-body: The link stops showing straight away. Its owner sees that it was removed and your reason. You can restore it later.
admin.delete-body: The page, its links, picture, passkeys and reports are deleted for good, and its owner is signed out. Anyone can then register /{slug} again. The reason is kept in the audit log.
admin.delete-mismatch: Type the page name exactly to confirm.
admin.remove-avatar-body: The picture is deleted straight away and the page shows its first letter instead. The owner can upload a new one.
admin.open-link: Open the link in a new tab
admin.blocked-slugs-body: Nobody can register these. A page already using one is not affected; take it down from Pages.
admin.blocked-domains-body: Links to these domains, and any subdomain of them, cannot be added and stop showing within a minute.
admin.passkeys-body: A passkey added here signs you in to this dashboard only. Your authenticator app and backup codes are managed on gftv.asia.
admin.no-passkeys: No passkeys on this site yet.

edit.review-notice: The GFTV team checks pages with names like yours before they go live. Set your page up now; it appears as soon as it is approved.
edit.quarantine-notice: Your page is paused while the GFTV team checks it, because several addresses you tried to add are on lists of harmful sites. Visitors see that it is being checked. If this is a mistake, it will be released soon.
redirect.title: Send visitors straight to one link
redirect.help: Instead of your links, visitors see where they are going for five seconds, then go there. Your links are kept for when you turn this off.
redirect.links-note: Your page is redirecting, so visitors do not see these links. They are kept for when you turn the redirect off.
security.keep-live-body: Sign in at least once a year. A page nobody signs in to for a year is hidden until its owner signs in again; nothing is deleted, and Telegram reminds you a month before if it is linked.
security.keep-live-until: Live until {date} unless you sign in again before then
stats.title: Insights
stats.privacy: Only daily totals are kept: no names, addresses or anything else that says who a visitor is. A visitor counts once per half hour.
profile.dormant-body: Its owner has not signed in for over a year, so it is hidden for now. If it is yours, sign in to bring it straight back.
profile.review-body: The GFTV team is checking this page before it is shown. Please try again later.
report.about-redirect: You are reporting links.gftv.asia/{slug}, which sends visitors to {url}.
redirect.heading: You will be redirected to
redirect.paused: Paused. Go when you are ready.
redirect.check-address: Check the address before you go. If something looks wrong, report it.
admin.threat-lists-body: Links are also checked against HaGeZi's lists of harmful sites, gambling, shortened links and adult content, and against Google Safe Browsing when its key is set. Links already on a page are checked again every day, and the lists are fetched again every two weeks.
admin.threat-info.one: {n} domain, fetched {when}. Fetched again every {days} days.
admin.threat-info.other: {n} domains, fetched {when}. Fetched again every {days} days.
admin.threat-none: Not fetched yet. The daily job fetches them, or fetch them now.
admin.threat-off: The domain lists are switched off (DOMAIN_BLOCKLISTS is "off").
admin.blocked-patterns-body: Regular expressions, matched without regard to case. For links, any address that matches is refused and stops showing within a minute; for page names, matching names cannot be registered.
admin.review-names-body: A page name that matches one of these patterns can be registered, but the page stays hidden until someone approves it under Pages, Awaiting approval.
admin.testimonials-body: Shown under "Loved by the community" on the home page, in this order. Only add what people actually said, with their permission. The section is hidden while none are visible.
regex.title: Pattern helper
regex.body: Describe what to catch and the helper writes the pattern. Upper and lower case are treated the same.
regex.hint-links: Links are checked as full addresses, like https://example.com/page.
regex.hint-names: Page names are checked as typed: lowercase letters, numbers and dashes.
regex.terms-hint: Separate several with commas; any one of them matches.
regex.lookalike: Also catch look-alike spellings (0 for o, 1 for i, 3 for e and so on)
regex.spaced: Also catch letters split by dots, dashes or underscores (g.f.t.v)
regex.empty: Type a word above to build a pattern.
regex.try-placeholder: A name or address to test
regex.no-match: No match: this would get through
regex.need-terms: Type at least one word or phrase.
home.share-title: Share your OneLink anywhere you like!
home.share-body: Put your link in every bio, on stream, on your con badge and on your business cards. Then let your QR code bring people at meets and conventions straight back to you.
home.insights-title: See who's visiting and keep them coming back
home.insights-body: Your page counts its visits and clicks every day, and shows where visitors are, which sites sent them and what they read it on. Only daily totals are kept, never who someone is.
home.tiles-note: Live totals from OneLink and GFTV links, updated every ten minutes.
home.cta-title: Your corner of the internet, one link away
faq.free-a: No. Making a page and keeping it is free, with no paid tiers.
faq.email-q: Do I need an email address?
faq.email-a: No. Your page is your account: its name, a password, and a second step such as an authenticator app or a passkey. Link Telegram as well if you want a way to reset a forgotten password.
faq.phone-q: What if I lose my phone?
faq.phone-a: Sign in with your password and one of the ten backup codes you saved when you set up your page, or with a code sent to your linked Telegram. Then set up your new phone from Security.
faq.redirect-q: Can my page go straight to one link?
faq.redirect-a: Yes. Turn on the redirect in your editor and visitors see where they are going for five seconds, with a chance to report it, and then go there. Your links are kept for when you turn it off.
faq.dormant-q: What happens if I do not sign in for a while?
faq.dormant-a: Pages need a sign-in at least once a year to stay live. A page nobody has signed in to for a year is hidden until its owner signs in again. Nothing is deleted, and if you linked Telegram you get a reminder a month before.
faq.stats-q: What can I see about my visitors?
faq.stats-a: Daily totals: visits, clicks, the countries visitors are in, which sites sent them and whether they used a phone, tablet or computer. Nothing that says who a visitor is is ever kept.
faq.links-a: Any web address starting with http or https, except shortened links (they hide where they go) and sites on the threat lists we check against. Anyone can report a page or link, and the GFTV team reviews every report.
faq.who-a: Global Furry Television's Technology and Infrastructure Development Sub-Committee (TIDSC), from Singapore. Check the bar at the top of the page to see how to recognise an official GFTV site.
